name: Dispatch Report
query:
SELECT
    si.posting_date AS "Date",
    si.customer AS "Party Name",
    i.item_name AS "Product",

    TRUNCATE(sii.qty, 2) AS "Quantity",
    TRUNCATE(sii.rate, 2) AS "Rate",
    TRUNCATE(sii.amount, 2) AS "Basic Value",

    TRUNCATE(sii.sgst_amount, 2) AS "SGST",
    TRUNCATE(sii.cgst_amount, 2) AS "CGST",
    TRUNCATE(sii.igst_amount, 2) AS "IGST",

    TRUNCATE(si.grand_total, 2) AS "INV Value",
    si.name AS "Inv No",
    si.vehicle_no AS "Vehicle No",

    TRUNCATE(so.total_qty, 2) AS "Order Qty",
    TRUNCATE((so.per_delivered * so.total_qty / 100), 2) AS "Total Dispatch",
    TRUNCATE((so.total_qty - (so.per_delivered * so.total_qty / 100)), 2) AS "Order Bal Qty",

    TRUNCATE((so.grand_total - si.grand_total), 2) AS "Balance amount +/-"

FROM `tabSales Invoice` si
JOIN `tabSales Invoice Item` sii ON sii.parent = si.name
LEFT JOIN `tabSales Order` so ON so.name = sii.sales_order
LEFT JOIN `tabItem` i ON i.item_code = sii.item_code

ORDER BY si.posting_date DESC;

name: Dispatch Product Summary
query:
SELECT
    IFNULL(i.item_name, 'Total') AS "Product",
    SUM(sii.qty) AS "Total Summary Quantity"
FROM `tabSales Invoice Item` sii
JOIN `tabSales Invoice` si ON sii.parent = si.name
LEFT JOIN `tabItem` i ON i.item_code = sii.item_code
GROUP BY i.item_name WITH ROLLUP;

name: Sales Statement
query:
SELECT
    si.name AS "Invoice No:Link/Sales Invoice:150",
    si.posting_date AS "Posting Date:Date:120",
    si.customer AS "Customer:Link/Customer:200",
    si.base_net_total AS "Net Total:Currency:150",
    si.base_total_taxes_and_charges AS "Taxes:Currency:150",
    si.base_grand_total AS "Grand Total:Currency:180",
    si.status AS "Status:Data:120"
FROM 
    `tabSales Invoice` si
WHERE
    ( %(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s='' OR si.posting_date >= %(from_date)s )
    AND ( %(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s='' OR si.posting_date <= %(to_date)s )
    AND ( %(customer)s IS NULL OR %(customer)s='' OR si.customer = %(customer)s )
ORDER BY 
    si.posting_date DESC;

name: Salary Details
query:
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ss.employee) AS "Sl No:Int:40",
    ss.employee AS "Employee Code:Link/Employee:100",
    ss.employee_name AS "Employee Name:Data:180",
    e.designation AS "Designation:Data:150",

    -- ATTENDANCE
    COALESCE(att.paid_days, 0) AS "Paid Days:Int:80",
    COALESCE(att.absent_days, 0) AS "Absent:Int:70",
    COALESCE(att.total_days, 0) AS "Total Days:Int:80",

    -- GROSS
    ss.gross_pay AS "Gross Salary:Currency:110",
    ss.gross_pay AS "Earned Salary:Currency:120",

    COALESCE(
        (SELECT amount FROM `tabSalary Detail`
         WHERE parent = ss.name AND salary_component = 'Basic' AND parentfield = 'earnings'),
        0
    ) AS "Basic:Currency:100",

    COALESCE(
        (SELECT amount FROM `tabSalary Detail`
         WHERE parent = ss.name
           AND salary_component IN ('DA', 'Dearness Allowance', 'D.A.')
           AND parentfield = 'earnings'),
        0
    ) AS "DA:Currency:100",

    COALESCE(
        (SELECT amount FROM `tabSalary Detail`
         WHERE parent = ss.name
           AND salary_component IN ('HRA', 'House Rent Allowance')
           AND parentfield = 'earnings'),
        0
    ) AS "HRA:Currency:100",

    COALESCE(
        (SELECT amount FROM `tabSalary Detail`
         WHERE parent = ss.name
           AND salary_component IN ('Medical Allowance', 'Medical', 'MED')
           AND parentfield = 'earnings'),
        0
    ) AS "MED:Currency:100",

    ss.total_deduction AS "Total Deduction:Currency:120",
    ss.net_pay AS "Net Salary:Currency:120"

FROM
    `tabSalary Slip` ss

INNER JOIN
    `tabEmployee` e
        ON ss.employee = e.name
        AND e.department = %(department)s   -- ✅ STRICT DEPARTMENT FILTER

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        employee,
        SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('Present', 'Work From Home', 'Half Day') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paid_days,
        SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Absent' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS absent_days,
        COUNT(*) AS total_days
    FROM
        `tabAttendance`
    WHERE
        MONTH(attendance_date) = MONTH(%(from_date)s)
        AND YEAR(attendance_date) = YEAR(%(from_date)s)
        AND docstatus = 1
    GROUP BY
        employee
) att ON ss.employee = att.employee

WHERE
    ss.docstatus = 1
    AND MONTH(ss.start_date) = MONTH(%(from_date)s)
    AND YEAR(ss.start_date) = YEAR(%(from_date)s)

ORDER BY
    ss.employee;

report_script:
from __future__ import unicode_literals
import frappe
from frappe import _

def execute(filters=None):
    if not filters:
        filters = {}

    columns = get_columns()
    data = get_data(filters)
    return columns, data


def get_columns():
    return [
        {
            "label": _("Customer Name"),
            "fieldname": "customer_name",
            "fieldtype": "Data",
            "width": 220
        },
        {
            "label": _("GST NO"),
            "fieldname": "gst_no",
            "fieldtype": "Data",
            "width": 160
        },
        {
            "label": _("Qty"),
            "fieldname": "qty",
            "fieldtype": "Float",
            "width": 90,
            "precision": 3
        },
        {
            "label": _("B.Amount"),
            "fieldname": "base_amount",
            "fieldtype": "Currency",
            "width": 120
        },
        {
            "label": _("IGST"),
            "fieldname": "igst",
            "fieldtype": "Currency",
            "width": 110
        },
        {
            "label": _("CGST"),
            "fieldname": "cgst",
            "fieldtype": "Currency",
            "width": 110
        },
        {
            "label": _("SGST"),
            "fieldname": "sgst",
            "fieldtype": "Currency",
            "width": 110
        },
        {
            "label": _("Cess"),
            "fieldname": "cess",
            "fieldtype": "Currency",
            "width": 90
        },
        {
            "label": _("GST Value"),
            "fieldname": "gst_value",
            "fieldtype": "Currency",
            "width": 120
        },
        {
            "label": _("INV Value"),
            "fieldname": "inv_value",
            "fieldtype": "Currency",
            "width": 130
        },
    ]


def get_data(filters):
    from_date = filters.get("from_date")
    to_date   = filters.get("to_date")
    company   = filters.get("company")

    conditions = "si.docstatus = 1"
    if from_date:
        conditions += " AND si.posting_date >= %(from_date)s"
    if to_date:
        conditions += " AND si.posting_date <= %(to_date)s"
    if company:
        conditions += " AND si.company = %(company)s"

    # Fetch all invoice items with tax breakdown
    rows = frappe.db.sql("""
        SELECT
            si.name                          AS invoice,
            si.customer_name                 AS customer_name,
            si.customer_gstin                AS gst_no,
            si.place_of_supply               AS place_of_supply,
            si.company_gstin                 AS company_gstin,
            sii.item_name                    AS item_name,
            sii.qty                          AS qty,
            sii.base_net_amount              AS base_amount,
            si.grand_total                   AS inv_value,
            IFNULL((
                SELECT SUM(st.base_tax_amount_after_discount_amount)
                FROM `tabSales Taxes and Charges` st
                WHERE st.parent = si.name
                AND st.account_head LIKE '%%IGST%%'
            ), 0)                            AS igst,
            IFNULL((
                SELECT SUM(st.base_tax_amount_after_discount_amount)
                FROM `tabSales Taxes and Charges` st
                WHERE st.parent = si.name
                AND st.account_head LIKE '%%CGST%%'
            ), 0)                            AS cgst,
            IFNULL((
                SELECT SUM(st.base_tax_amount_after_discount_amount)
                FROM `tabSales Taxes and Charges` st
                WHERE st.parent = si.name
                AND st.account_head LIKE '%%SGST%%'
            ), 0)                            AS sgst,
            IFNULL((
                SELECT SUM(st.base_tax_amount_after_discount_amount)
                FROM `tabSales Taxes and Charges` st
                WHERE st.parent = si.name
                AND st.account_head LIKE '%%Cess%%'
            ), 0)                            AS cess
        FROM
            `tabSales Invoice` si
        INNER JOIN
            `tabSales Invoice Item` sii ON sii.parent = si.name
        WHERE
            {conditions}
        ORDER BY
            -- Inter-state first (place_of_supply state != company state), then within state
            CASE WHEN LEFT(si.place_of_supply, 2) != LEFT(si.company_gstin, 2) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
            sii.item_name,
            si.customer_name
    """.format(conditions=conditions), filters, as_dict=True)

    if not rows:
        return []

    # ── Separate inter-state vs within-state ──
    inter_state  = [r for r in rows if r.place_of_supply and r.company_gstin and
                    r.place_of_supply[:2] != r.company_gstin[:2]]
    within_state = [r for r in rows if r not in inter_state]

    data = []

    # ── Build section ──
    def build_section(section_rows, section_label):
        if not section_rows:
            return

        # Section header
        data.append({
            "customer_name": section_label,
            "bold": 1,
            "is_group": 1
        })

        # Group by item
        items = {}
        for r in section_rows:
            items.setdefault(r.item_name, []).append(r)

        grand = {"qty": 0, "base_amount": 0, "igst": 0, "cgst": 0,
                 "sgst": 0, "cess": 0, "gst_value": 0, "inv_value": 0}

        for item_name, item_rows in items.items():
            # Item name row
            data.append({"customer_name": item_name, "bold": 1})

            # Group by customer within item
            customers = {}
            for r in item_rows:
                customers.setdefault(r.customer_name, {
                    "customer_name": r.customer_name,
                    "gst_no": r.gst_no,
                    "qty": 0, "base_amount": 0,
                    "igst": 0, "cgst": 0, "sgst": 0,
                    "cess": 0, "gst_value": 0, "inv_value": 0
                })
                c = customers[r.customer_name]
                c["qty"]         += r.qty or 0
                c["base_amount"] += r.base_amount or 0
                c["igst"]        += r.igst or 0
                c["cgst"]        += r.cgst or 0
                c["sgst"]        += r.sgst or 0
                c["cess"]        += r.cess or 0
                c["inv_value"]   += r.inv_value or 0

            item_totals = {"qty": 0, "base_amount": 0, "igst": 0,
                           "cgst": 0, "sgst": 0, "cess": 0,
                           "gst_value": 0, "inv_value": 0}

            for cust in customers.values():
                cust["gst_value"] = cust["igst"] + cust["cgst"] + cust["sgst"] + cust["cess"]
                data.append(cust)
                for k in item_totals:
                    item_totals[k] += cust.get(k, 0)

            item_totals["gst_value"] = (item_totals["igst"] + item_totals["cgst"] +
                                        item_totals["sgst"] + item_totals["cess"])

            # Product wise Total row
            data.append({
                "customer_name": "Product wise Total",
                "bold": 1,
                **item_totals
            })

            for k in grand:
                grand[k] += item_totals.get(k, 0)

        # Section TOTAL row
        grand["gst_value"] = grand["igst"] + grand["cgst"] + grand["sgst"] + grand["cess"]
        data.append({
            "customer_name": "TOTAL",
            "bold": 1,
            **grand
        })
        # Blank separator row
        data.append({})

    build_section(inter_state,  "Inter state sales")
    build_section(within_state, "Within state sales")

    return data

name: Sales Abstract Report Q
query:
SELECT
    si.customer_name                                                        AS "Customer Name:Data:220",
    IFNULL(si.billing_address_gstin, '')                                   AS "GST NO:Data:160",
    IFNULL(sii.qty, 0)                                                     AS "Qty:Float:90",
    IFNULL(sii.base_net_amount, 0)                                         AS "B.Amount:Currency:120",

    -- IGST: proportional to this item line's share of total net amount
    ROUND(
        IFNULL((
            SELECT SUM(st.base_tax_amount_after_discount_amount)
            FROM `tabSales Taxes and Charges` st
            WHERE st.parent = si.name
            AND UPPER(st.account_head) LIKE CONCAT('%%', 'IGST', '%%')
        ), 0)
        * IFNULL(sii.base_net_amount, 0)
        / NULLIF(si.base_net_total, 0)
    , 2)                                                                    AS "IGST:Currency:110",

    -- CGST: proportional
    ROUND(
        IFNULL((
            SELECT SUM(st.base_tax_amount_after_discount_amount)
            FROM `tabSales Taxes and Charges` st
            WHERE st.parent = si.name
            AND UPPER(st.account_head) LIKE CONCAT('%%', 'CGST', '%%')
        ), 0)
        * IFNULL(sii.base_net_amount, 0)
        / NULLIF(si.base_net_total, 0)
    , 2)                                                                    AS "CGST:Currency:110",

    -- SGST: proportional
    ROUND(
        IFNULL((
            SELECT SUM(st.base_tax_amount_after_discount_amount)
            FROM `tabSales Taxes and Charges` st
            WHERE st.parent = si.name
            AND UPPER(st.account_head) LIKE CONCAT('%%', 'SGST', '%%')
        ), 0)
        * IFNULL(sii.base_net_amount, 0)
        / NULLIF(si.base_net_total, 0)
    , 2)                                                                    AS "SGST:Currency:110",

    -- CESS: proportional
    ROUND(
        IFNULL((
            SELECT SUM(st.base_tax_amount_after_discount_amount)
            FROM `tabSales Taxes and Charges` st
            WHERE st.parent = si.name
            AND UPPER(st.account_head) LIKE CONCAT('%%', 'CESS', '%%')
        ), 0)
        * IFNULL(sii.base_net_amount, 0)
        / NULLIF(si.base_net_total, 0)
    , 2)                                                                    AS "Cess:Currency:90",

    -- GST Value: proportional total of all GST
    ROUND(
        IFNULL((
            SELECT SUM(st.base_tax_amount_after_discount_amount)
            FROM `tabSales Taxes and Charges` st
            WHERE st.parent = si.name
            AND (
                UPPER(st.account_head) LIKE CONCAT('%%', 'IGST', '%%')
                OR UPPER(st.account_head) LIKE CONCAT('%%', 'CGST', '%%')
                OR UPPER(st.account_head) LIKE CONCAT('%%', 'SGST', '%%')
                OR UPPER(st.account_head) LIKE CONCAT('%%', 'CESS', '%%')
            )
        ), 0)
        * IFNULL(sii.base_net_amount, 0)
        / NULLIF(si.base_net_total, 0)
    , 2)                                                                    AS "GST Value:Currency:120",

    -- INV Value: proportional to item line
    ROUND(
        IFNULL(si.grand_total, 0)
        * IFNULL(sii.base_net_amount, 0)
        / NULLIF(si.base_net_total, 0)
    , 2)                                                                    AS "INV Value:Currency:130"

FROM
    `tabSales Invoice` si
INNER JOIN
    `tabSales Invoice Item` sii ON sii.parent = si.name

WHERE
    si.docstatus = 1
    AND si.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
    AND si.company LIKE %(company)s

ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN LEFT(IFNULL(si.place_of_supply, ''), 2)
             != LEFT(IFNULL(si.company_gstin, ''), 2)
        THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END,
    sii.item_name,
    si.customer_name

name: PO Wise Sales Report
query:
SELECT
    so.transaction_date                                                     AS "PO Date:Date:100",
    so.customer_name                                                        AS "Party Name:Data:150",
    soi.item_name                                                           AS "Product:Data:130",
    IFNULL(so.custom_agent, 'Direct')                                       AS "Agent:Data:100",
    so.name                                                                 AS "PO No.:Data:130",
    IFNULL(soi.qty, 0)                                                      AS "PO Qty:Float:80",
    IFNULL(soi.rate, 0)                                                     AS "Rate:Float:90",
    IFNULL(soi.base_net_amount, 0)                                          AS "Basic Amount:Currency:120",

    ROUND(
        IFNULL((
            SELECT SUM(st.base_tax_amount_after_discount_amount)
            FROM `tabSales Taxes and Charges` st
            WHERE st.parent = so.name
            AND UPPER(st.account_head) LIKE CONCAT('%%', 'CGST', '%%')
        ), 0)
        * IFNULL(soi.base_net_amount, 0)
        / NULLIF(so.base_net_total, 0)
    , 2)                                                                    AS "CGST:Currency:100",

    ROUND(
        IFNULL((
            SELECT SUM(st.base_tax_amount_after_discount_amount)
            FROM `tabSales Taxes and Charges` st
            WHERE st.parent = so.name
            AND UPPER(st.account_head) LIKE CONCAT('%%', 'SGST', '%%')
        ), 0)
        * IFNULL(soi.base_net_amount, 0)
        / NULLIF(so.base_net_total, 0)
    , 2)                                                                    AS "SGST:Currency:100",

    ROUND(
        IFNULL((
            SELECT SUM(st.base_tax_amount_after_discount_amount)
            FROM `tabSales Taxes and Charges` st
            WHERE st.parent = so.name
            AND UPPER(st.account_head) LIKE CONCAT('%%', 'IGST', '%%')
        ), 0)
        * IFNULL(soi.base_net_amount, 0)
        / NULLIF(so.base_net_total, 0)
    , 2)                                                                    AS "IGST:Currency:100",

    ROUND(
        IFNULL(soi.base_net_amount, 0)
        + (
            IFNULL((
                SELECT SUM(st.base_tax_amount_after_discount_amount)
                FROM `tabSales Taxes and Charges` st
                WHERE st.parent = so.name
                AND (
                    UPPER(st.account_head) LIKE CONCAT('%%', 'IGST', '%%')
                    OR UPPER(st.account_head) LIKE CONCAT('%%', 'CGST', '%%')
                    OR UPPER(st.account_head) LIKE CONCAT('%%', 'SGST', '%%')
                )
            ), 0)
            * IFNULL(soi.base_net_amount, 0)
            / NULLIF(so.base_net_total, 0)
        )
    , 2)                                                                    AS "Total:Currency:120",

    IFNULL((
        SELECT SUM(dni.qty)
        FROM `tabDelivery Note Item` dni
        INNER JOIN `tabDelivery Note` dn ON dn.name = dni.parent
        WHERE dni.against_sales_order = so.name
        AND dni.item_code = soi.item_code
        AND dn.docstatus = 1
    ), 0)                                                                   AS "Dispatch Qty.:Float:100",

    IFNULL(soi.qty, 0) - IFNULL((
        SELECT SUM(dni.qty)
        FROM `tabDelivery Note Item` dni
        INNER JOIN `tabDelivery Note` dn ON dn.name = dni.parent
        WHERE dni.against_sales_order = so.name
        AND dni.item_code = soi.item_code
        AND dn.docstatus = 1
    ), 0)                                                                   AS "Balance Supply Qty.:Float:120",

    IFNULL((
        SELECT SUM(pe.paid_amount)
        FROM `tabPayment Entry` pe
        INNER JOIN `tabPayment Entry Reference` per ON per.parent = pe.name
        WHERE per.reference_name = so.name
        AND pe.payment_type = 'Receive'
        AND pe.docstatus = 1
    ), 0)                                                                   AS "Advance Received:Currency:130",

    ROUND(
        IFNULL(so.grand_total, 0)
        - IFNULL((
            SELECT SUM(pe.paid_amount)
            FROM `tabPayment Entry` pe
            INNER JOIN `tabPayment Entry Reference` per ON per.parent = pe.name
            WHERE per.reference_name = so.name
            AND pe.payment_type = 'Receive'
            AND pe.docstatus = 1
        ), 0)
    , 2)                                                                    AS "Balance Receivable:Currency:130"

FROM
    `tabSales Order` so
INNER JOIN
    `tabSales Order Item` soi ON soi.parent = so.name

WHERE
    so.docstatus = 1
    AND so.transaction_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s

ORDER BY
    so.transaction_date,
    so.customer_name,
    soi.item_name

query:
WITH RECURSIVE cteItemGroup (
    group_id,
    group_name,
    parent_id,
    group_level,
    lft
)
AS (

    SELECT
        name                    AS group_id,
        name                    AS group_name,
        parent_item_group       AS parent_id,
        1                       AS group_level,
        lft
    FROM
        `tabItem Group`
    WHERE
        name = 'ERP Items'
        AND is_group = 1

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        someGroup.name,
        someGroup.name,
        someGroup.parent_item_group,
        cteItemGroup.group_level + 1,
        someGroup.lft
    FROM
        `tabItem Group` AS someGroup
    INNER JOIN
        cteItemGroup
        ON someGroup.parent_item_group = cteItemGroup.group_id
    WHERE
        someGroup.name <> 'MIGRATED MATERIALS'
)

SELECT
    CONCAT(SPACE(group_level * 4), group_id) AS ItemGroup_Indented,
    group_id                                 AS ItemGroup,
    group_level                              AS ItemGroupLevel,
    tabItem.item_code                        AS ItemCode,
    tabItem.item_name                        AS ItemName
FROM
    cteItemGroup
LEFT JOIN
    `tabItem`
    ON tabItem.item_group = cteItemGroup.group_id
ORDER BY
    lft;
